purpose: Test whether the grouped MLP6--7 midpoint-quadratic transport law survives a fronted two-attractor syntax shift whose text and whole-MLP8 outcomes were already opened but whose grouped-source tangent intervention is prospective.

binding_evidence.finding: All 48 registered OOD recipient, opposite-number, and same-number lexical endpoints are natively capable.
The scoped OOD intervention license passes and binds the native-capability receipt.
Exact MLP8 cross/quadratic signed cancellation and lexical specificity transfer to this already-open OOD syntax.
On licensed matched HOLDOUT text, the midpoint JVP predicts the finite grouped-source head effect with minimum cosine 0.999927 and maximum relative error 0.013932; endpoint JVP fails.

novelty_audit: The canonical Task14 authority contains no OOD MLP6--7 source split, tangent, or gain event.
Repository prior-art searches for {mlp6_7, OOD} and {quadratic, gain, OOD} return zero events.
This changes syntax and tests a new grouped-source intervention. It does not repeat the already-complete matched-text child factorial or the OOD whole-MLP8 response split.
map: Reuse the 16 balanced fronted two-attractor rows. At subject position 8, form the same grouped X=MLP6+MLP7 displacement under recipient and donor E/A/U/W contexts for opposite-number and same-number lexical sources. Compare exact finite L11H3 head deltas with endpoint and midpoint JVP deltas through native MLP8, blocks 9--11, the fixed recipient L11H3 score/cached value/non-subject complement, and the native tail.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: All replay, no-op, state, normalized-state, and finite-tensor gates are at most 5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_ood_midpoint_geometry: For every opposite-number direction/background cell, midpoint head-delta cosine is at least 0.95 and relative error is at most 0.25.
predictions.pred_c_ood_midpoint_task_prediction: At least two of four opposite-number direction/background cells have absolute exact task-margin effect at least 0.002; for every such live cell, installed midpoint task recovery is in [0.70,1.30] with the exact sign.
predictions.pred_d_matched_strength_transfers: Every opposite-number cell has cosine at least 0.989 and relative error at most 0.064, allowing 0.01 cosine and 0.05 relative-error degradation from the matched-text worst cases.
predictions.pred_e_context_changes_readout: The mean midpoint relative error differs by at least 0.15 between recipient and donor E/A/U/W backgrounds in either grammatical direction.
predictions.pred_f_ood_lexical_specificity: For exact and midpoint arms in every background/direction cell, absolute same-number lexical task-margin effect is at most 25% of the matched opposite-number exact effect, with denominator floored at 0.002.

null: If the instrument holds but prediction b fails, the grouped-source quadratic law does not transfer to fronted syntax. If b holds but fewer than two task cells are live, retain only an OOD head-geometry screen and do not claim behavioral prediction. If b and c hold but d fails, the law transfers qualitatively but with construction-dependent higher-order error.

price.backwards: two JVPs per source/background; no optimization

closed_claims: necessity outside the fixed L11H3 interface
